# Algorithmacy

> Algorithmacy is two programs on one site. The 2026 conference, held in Port of Spain from 28 to 31 October, has concluded. The call for papers for the Second Algorithmacy Conference (2027) is open. Its theme is Decision Experience Design. Dates and venue to be announced. Algorithmacy Studio installs a local model on a computer a small office or a home owns, and maintains it.

Studio's decision guide works for an AI tool that can fetch URLs and for one that cannot. The copied prompt and the files below carry the same facts: three ways to run AI, hardware tiers, the first 10 free-labor offer, and a booking link the tool can fill in.

## Studio

- [Studio](https://algorithmacy.org/studio): the offer for a small office or a home. A local model on a computer the client owns.
- [LLM decision harness](https://algorithmacy.org/studio/llm-harness.md): the full prompt. An AI tool with no web access can run the decision from this file alone.
- [Copy prompt](https://algorithmacy.org/studio/prompt.txt): the short prompt the Studio page copies. It points an AI tool at the harness, the facts, and the GitHub repo.
- [Facts JSON](https://algorithmacy.org/studio/facts.json): profile, 3-way comparison, hardware tiers, pricing, the first 10 offer, HIPAA boundaries, engineers, MCP endpoints, and the /book query parameters.
- [Full text](https://algorithmacy.org/llms-full.txt): conference reference plus the Studio offering and the full decision harness.
- [Book a call](https://algorithmacy.org/book): a 20-minute call. Query parameters such as setting, org, software, users, offer, summary, name, email, and notes prefill the form.
- [Studio MCP](https://algorithmacy.org/api/studio-mcp): signed-in connector for an office that already has an account. It cannot charge a card.
- [Onboarding MCP](https://algorithmacy.org/api/onboarding-mcp): no key. Books a discovery call or explains the offer. A call is not an account.
- [Agent card](https://algorithmacy.org/.well-known/agent.json): discovery card for the public files, the MCP endpoints, and booking.

## Conference

The 2026 conference has concluded. The 2027 call for papers is open. Its theme is Decision Experience Design. Dates and venue to be announced. The call is written as of October 2026: a designer used to guide a user toward an agreed end, such as buying a raincoat; with agents such as Claude or Grok Bot, the person may instead arrive at an umbrella, and neither the site nor the person gets what they wanted. Conversion rate, stickiness, and dark patterns are the wrong measures. The user is the human (agent-experience research is bracketed). The environment is a platform: opaque, cooptive, and triadic. The design move is an aesthetic shift. Engaging a large language model is treated as engaging an animation: missing frames, lock-in, and a viewer, a character, and an animator. The proposal is to learn animators' core methods and apply them.

2027 tracks, same ids as the submission form: TR.01 Decision surfacing; TR.02 Opacity and missing frames; TR.03 Cooptation, lock-in, and dark patterns; TR.04 User, character, and designer; TR.05 Animation methods and metrics. Submission types are unchanged: full paper, note, panel, poster, practitioner report. A 2027 submission is tagged with conference year 2027 so it does not replace a 2026 submission from the same email.

- [Home](https://algorithmacy.org/): thank-you for 2026, the 2027 call for papers, and the 2026 program at https://algorithmacy.org/#2026.
- [2027 call for papers](https://algorithmacy.org/#2027): Decision Experience Design. Web form on that tab, or the conference MCP with `conference` set to `2027`, or a GitHub pull request that includes `Conference: 2027`.
- [Submit a paper](https://algorithmacy.org/submit): the shared web form, conference MCP, and GitHub pull request. The human author confirms by email before a pull request opens. The home-page 2027 form posts to the same `/api/submit` endpoint with `conference` set to `2027`.
- [Conference MCP](https://algorithmacy.org/api/mcp): paper intake only. Do not use it for Studio.
- [Logistics](https://algorithmacy.org/logistics): venue, travel, visas, registration.
- [Repository](https://github.com/rogerSuperBuilderAlpha/algorithmacy-conference): submissions and open reviews live here as pull requests.
